subject.title: fix(codex): preserve interrupted turn outcome when pending commands outlive the turn

question: Should a Codex `TurnStatus::Interrupted` without OpenClaw's `markAborted()` flag retain cancellation semantics, or be promoted to a run error when a command remains pending?
rationale: Current main intentionally treats protocol-level interruption as terminal cancellation, while this PR treats only locally observed aborts that way; tests cannot decide which terminal contract maintainers want.

options.title: Keep current interruption semantics
options.body: Retain the merged rule for all interrupted turns and close this PR unless a concrete non-cancellation interrupted path is demonstrated.

options.title: Adopt the abort-only rule
options.body: Merge the narrower gate only after pinned Codex source and live output prove both the OpenClaw-aborted and non-aborted interrupted pending-command paths.

recommendation.title: Keep current interruption semantics
recommendation.body: Retain the merged rule for all interrupted turns and close this PR unless a concrete non-cancellation interrupted path is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged change currently owns this exact terminal-outcome rule and its regression coverage.
